residual_risks: The portability pin is a static source scan (regex over the package's .ts files) rather than a runtime ffmpeg probe; it guards the specific `-fps_mode` regression and requires `-vsync passthrough` in the three known re-timed fixtures, but would not catch other future ffmpeg >= 5-only options.
`-vsync` is deprecated (not removed) in ffmpeg 5.1+ and still accepted through 8.0; if a future ffmpeg drops it, the fixtures would need a version-conditional switch.

implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA 55d80326: root `pnpm test` exits 1 because @pickle/capture-envelope's synthetic ffmpeg fixtures pass `-fps_mode passthrough` — packages/capture-envelope/test/redteamEnvelope.test.ts:134 (VFR fixture) and packages/capture-envelope/test/redteamBypassF22.test.ts:269 (duplicate-PTS fixture). `-fps_mode` exists only in ffmpeg >= 5.1; Ubuntu 22.04 (the Linux verification plane and this VM) ships ffmpeg 4.4.2, which aborts with 'Unrecognized option fps_mode. Error splitting the argument list', so both fixture builds throw before their assertions and pnpm -r stops the workspace run. packages/capture-envelope/src/redteamF22.ts already uses `-vsync passthrough`, and repo history (commit 8aff8376 'ffmpeg fixtures use -vsync passthrough (ffmpeg 4.4+)') shows the fixtures had been fixed once and regressed in a later merge. format:check, lint and typecheck were already green on BASE_SHA. Fix (2 commits): (1) a810bc73 adds test/ffmpegPortability.test.ts, a static pin over every .ts in the package's src/ and test/ (excluding itself) asserting no quoted `-fps_mode` argument exists and that the three re-timed fixture files use `"-vsync", "passthrough"` — fails on BASE (2 of 3), passes on HEAD; (2) 7f2d720e changes the two fixture arguments from `-fps_mode` to `-vsync` (2-line diff). No existing test was weakened, skipped, reordered or edited beyond that flag; no comments modified; all edits under packages/ (write_paths).
